Gardens of Eden - Park Residences

Condominium in Bang Tao (Pa Sak / Choeng Thale, Thalang)
HomeNew ProjectsGardens of Eden - Park Residences

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Park Residences is the second residential phase of the Gardens of Eden master development by Amal Group, a large low-density resort community in Bang Tao on Phuket's west coast. It is described as 455 condominium units in seven-storey buildings, from one to three bedrooms, set within a landscaped community with parks and lakes. The development is marketed in collaboration with Etro, and residents share the master community's wellness, pool and leisure facilities.

Facilities & amenities

  • Park Residences club and pool (shown in developer renders)
  • Community: Wellness centre with 1,000 sqm gym
  • Community: Six swimming pools including a Blue Lagoon pool
  • Community: Eight restaurants and two kids' clubs
  • Community: Open-air cinema
  • Community: Planned 100-room 5-star hotel
  • Community: 6,000 sqm business centre
  • Community: Adventure Gardens, parks and walking paths (about 70% open space)

Frequently asked questions

Where is Gardens of Eden - Park Residences?

Gardens of Eden - Park Residences is a low-rise condominium project in Bang Tao (Pa Sak / Choeng Thale, Thalang), Phuket, developed by Amal Development Company Limited. Address: Pa Sak, Thalang District, Phuket 83110, Thailand.

What is the starting price of Gardens of Eden - Park Residences?

Agent advertised price is ฿13,908,240, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Gardens of Eden - Park Residences?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Gardens of Eden - Park Residences be ready?

Current status: under construction; completion date listed as Q4 2027. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
